Class BaseApp

java.lang.Object
application.apps.BaseApp
Direct Known Subclasses:
AdminApp, CommonMenus, DeanApp, EmployeeApp, ManagerApp, StudentApp, TeacherApp, TechSupportSpecialistApp, UniversityApplication
public abstract class BaseApp extends Object
Base class that every application must inherit. Gives tons of helpers for printing data, handling ApplicationException. Also contains subclass BaseApp.MenuBuilder, to create CLI menus quickly.
